controls.label: Amend premises
controls.implementation: Typed premises add/edit/remove proposal controls use product-specific source fields and stable identities. Both products persist additions and edits; Combined verifies exact sums and clearing an issued postcode. Modal retention through takeover, focus and mobile containment pass. Referenced-premises removal is rejected by server unit tests; full dependent cover removal awaits the cover editor.

controls.label: Amend trade activities
controls.implementation: Typed trade activity dialog reuses business declarations, exact GBP amounts, percentage controls and stable occupation rows. Both-product persisted browser checks verify incomplete saves, invalid percentage blocking, exact shares, occupation edit/remove, turnover clearing, lease retention and unchanged issued data.
